report.summary: Account linking via Account Aggregator failed due to an expired mTLS client certificate on aa-connector preventing secure connections to aa-fiu-gateway.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Expired mTLS Client Certificate on aa-connector

supporting.note: Logged warning that mTLS client certificate expires at 2026-10-08T13:30:00Z.
Logged SSL handshake failure with aa-fiu-gateway due to expired certificate exactly at onset time.
Shows error rate spiking sharply at 13:30.

contradicting.note: Logs explicitly attribute the failure to our own client certificate expiring, not an external gateway failure.

facts.text: aa-connector logged an mTLS client certificate expiration warning for 2026-10-08T13:30:00Z at 12:00:14Z.
aa-connector error rate spiked to nearly 100% starting at 2026-10-08T13:30:00Z.
aa-connector reported SSL handshake failures with aa-fiu-gateway due to certificate expiration starting at 13:30:03Z.
mobile-bff experienced an error rate increase starting at 13:30.

assumptions: The certificate was not automatically renewed due to an unconfigured or failing secret rotation operator.

timeline.event: aa-connector logs that its mTLS client certificate expires in 0 days.
mTLS client certificate expires; aa-connector error rate spikes.
First SSL handshake failure logged by aa-connector.

recommended_actions.action: Renew and deploy the expired mTLS client certificate for aa-connector.
recommended_actions.rationale: Directly resolves the SSL handshake failures and restores account linking functionality.

recommended_actions.action: Configure proactive alerts for certificate expiration 14 and 7 days prior.
recommended_actions.rationale: Prevents future unexpected outages from expired certificates.
